run_server_increment: run the python module to start a bottle HTTP server that increments a Redis counter on /increment
test_increment_endpoint: test the increment endpoint that returns the incremented Redis counter value as a string
build_redis_server: build an HTTP server using bottle that connects to Redis and increments a counter on request

summarize_increment_route: summarize the /increment route that increments a Redis key and returns the result as a string
